cases.title: A Gateway partition loses no work and duplicates nothing
cases.when: One Gateway replica is partitioned mid-load
then: Ledger tools execute at most once; clients retrying elsewhere get EXISTING or the task

cases.title: A Tool Host partition is bounded by deadlines
cases.when: A host is partitioned under load
then: No new admission; running work ends by deadline or selfTerminateOnControlLoss; ledger work OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

cases.title: Store failover keeps acknowledged commits
cases.when: The PostgreSQL primary fails over under load
then: No acknowledged transition is lost; callers re-read by invocationId

cases.title: Kill propagation timing
cases.when: A TERMINATE kill commits under load across all hosts
then: New work stops at commit; push acknowledgements and terminations are measured and reported per component

cases.title: Warm pools never leak across tenants under load
cases.when: Two tenants run stateless tools with reuse at peak load
then: No sandbox serves two tenants or identity classes; canary values never cross

cases.title: Resource exhaustion is contained per sandbox
cases.when: A tool forks, allocates memory and fills disk past its quotas
then: The sandbox is killed; other sandboxes on the host meet their latency budget
